appearance_facts.fact: The chart is titled 'Falling Respiratory Infection Cases in Sentinel Sites from 2012 to 2023'.
The y-axis is labeled 'Respiratory infection cases' with tick marks at 0, 700, 1400, 2100, and 2800.
The x-axis is labeled 'Year' and spans from 2012 to 2023.
A single purple line represents the trend of respiratory infection cases over time.
The line starts at approximately 1000 cases in 2012, rises to about 1400 in 2014, dips to around 1200 in 2015, and then generally increases to a peak of approximately 2900 in 2022.
The line shows a decline from the 2022 peak to approximately 2800 cases in 2023.
